title: Content guardrails on LLM calls
one_line: Redact PII and secrets, flag prompt injection, block bad completions.
verified_against: Enforced through the openai 3.57.0, anthropic 2.12.0, google-genai 3.6.1 and botocore 1.44.9 clients over fake transports (no real provider call). PII detection tested with the pure-Python detectors only: the native Sanitizer is not built in this environment, its adapter was tested with a stand-in. Injection heuristics are a small pattern set, not evaluated against an attack corpus.
snippet:
import briefcase
from briefcase.guardrails import content

briefcase.auto()
content.guard(
    content.pii(input="redact", output="warn"),
    content.injection(effect="block"),
    content.output_regex(r"(?i)internal use only", effect="block"),
)
docs = content.retrieved("text from your search index")  # checked as untrusted
